name: diagram-js
summary: The modeling toolkit behind bpmn-js and Camunda Modeler. It has a production-proven command stack, selection, palette, context pad, outline, keyboard and modeling architecture. It is a modeler framework rather than a ready-made draw.io shape library: you supply the shapes and rules.
gains: Used by bpmn-js and Camunda Modeler
losses: Not a general shape/stencil library out of the box

spike.scenario: Documented ecosystem analysis; no local browser spike.
spike.notes: No screenshot. The assessment is based on the project documentation, public adoption and package metadata.
